title: Walsh-Hadamard ECG anomaly scoring: reproducibility package with PTB-XL real-data pilot
description: Public reproducibility package for the Walsh-Hadamard ECG anomaly-scoring study. This version adds a real-data PTB-XL pilot layer to the previous synthetic verification package. It includes code, a Colab notebook, real-data PTB-XL pilot outputs, tables, figures, operator-identity verification files, and run metadata. The manuscript itself is not included in this public archive because it is under journal submission. The PTB-XL pilot is intended as methodological real-data verification and stress testing of the Walsh-Hadamard quadratic reference operator; it is not claimed as clinical diagnostic validation.
